svg.title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Contact or Routing
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-channel-and-commercial-risk-decisions; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Contact or Routing; subtitle: Each check has an explicit proceed condition and an explicit stop-and-repair branch.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values identify check order, not risk scores. Evaluate each channel separately and document why an unused channel is disabled. Federal rules are the starting point; applicable state privacy, calling, and recording requirements also depend on the parties, locations, technology, and campaign facts.; caption: Proceed only when every applicable check has evidence. Missing permission, unresolved suppression, unsupported routing, or ambiguous acceptance criteria sends the affected activity back for repair.; stages: label: Commercial-email requirements; value: Proceed with truthful identity and functioning opt-out handling.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. 7704: accurate header information, nondeceptive subjects, required advertising identification unless an exception applies, valid physical postal address, and a functioning opt-out. Honor opt-outs within ten business days; stop affected sends when suppression fails.; label: Calling and recording requirements; value: Proceed only after documenting the specific calling basis.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Check 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, applicable 16 CFR Part 310 duties, and state calling and recording rules. Distinguish live manual calls from automated or prerecorded activity and business numbers from personal wireless numbers. Disable unsupported dialing or recording.; label: Privacy and data handling; value: Proceed with documented scope, purpose, and rights handling.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Assess California Civil Code 1798.100, 1798.120, and 1798.140 where applicable, plus other relevant state rules. Document client and vendor roles, collection notices, retention, access controls, and rights-request ownership. Stop transfers that conflict with applicable sale or sharing choices.; label: Quality and commercial exposure; value: Proceed with measurable acceptance and bounded delivery commitments.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Sign territory, qualification, duplicate, acceptance, replacement, fee, and dispute terms. Test routing capacity and assign a suppression owner. Pause the affected campaign when rejection costs, acquisition costs, or churn erase its modeled contribution.

text.title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Contact or Routing
text.tspan: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Contact or Routing

rect.title: label: Commercial-email requirements; value: Proceed with truthful identity and functioning opt-out handling.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. 7704: accurate header information, nondeceptive subjects, required advertising identification unless an exception applies, valid physical postal address, and a functioning opt-out. Honor opt-outs within ten business days; stop affected sends when suppression fails.

text.title: Apply 15 U.S.C. 7704: accurate header information, nondeceptive subjects, required advertising identification unless an exception applies, valid physical postal address, and a functioning opt-out. Honor opt-outs within ten business days; stop affected sends when suppression fails.

rect.title: label: Calling and recording requirements; value: Proceed only after documenting the specific calling basis.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Check 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, applicable 16 CFR Part 310 duties, and state calling and recording rules. Distinguish live manual calls from automated or prerecorded activity and business numbers from personal wireless numbers. Disable unsupported dialing or recording.

text.title: Check 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, applicable 16 CFR Part 310 duties, and state calling and recording rules. Distinguish live manual calls from automated or prerecorded activity and business numbers from personal wireless numbers. Disable unsupported dialing or recording.

rect.title: label: Privacy and data handling; value: Proceed with documented scope, purpose, and rights handling.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Assess California Civil Code 1798.100, 1798.120, and 1798.140 where applicable, plus other relevant state rules. Document client and vendor roles, collection notices, retention, access controls, and rights-request ownership. Stop transfers that conflict with applicable sale or sharing choices.

text.title: Assess California Civil Code 1798.100, 1798.120, and 1798.140 where applicable, plus other relevant state rules. Document client and vendor roles, collection notices, retention, access controls, and rights-request ownership. Stop transfers that conflict with applicable sale or sharing choices.

rect.title: label: Quality and commercial exposure; value: Proceed with measurable acceptance and bounded delivery commitments.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Sign territory, qualification, duplicate, acceptance, replacement, fee, and dispute terms. Test routing capacity and assign a suppression owner. Pause the affected campaign when rejection costs, acquisition costs, or churn erase its modeled contribution.

Assumptions: Numeric values identify check order, not risk scores. Evaluate each channel separately and document why an unused channel is disabled. Federal rules are the starting point; applicable state privacy, calling, and recording requirements also depend on the parties, locations, technology, and campaign facts.
